ns2:section.sectionText: Explore modern Germany and Europe through examples of popular culture from the late eighteenth century to the present. Look at texts and films as mirrors and critiques of modern Western society. Topics discussed include: nationalism, gender, ethnicity, minority cultures, Jewish life in Germany, German images of other cultures, and more. This course is taught in English. This course fulfills General Education requirements for Literature and the Arts, and for Western and Comparative Culture.
